paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.39% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.57%) and Nasdaq weakest (-1.07%). Brent crude changed +1.67% to 106.52. Gold changed -1.39% to 3,914.3. Bitcoin changed +0.38% to 76,968.0625. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.894%, a relative move of -0.71%. Among the firms tracked, US Oil Fund (ETF) (-7.08%) and Equinor (-6.87%) moved the most.
